# 3BrainAI

> 3BrainAI is the public brand for governed, review-ready evidence workflows. 3BrainAI Nexus s.r.o. develops 3BrainAI CRI for physical-asset risk monitoring.

## Core product

- [3BrainAI CRI](https://www.3brain.ai/cri/): Construction Risk Intelligence turns Earth Observation and project-context inputs into governed Evidence Packs with explicit uncertainty, provenance and human review.
- [Evidence Pack sample](https://www.3brain.ai/#evidence-pack-sample): Synthetic public-safe example; not a live customer assessment.
- [Validation](https://www.3brain.ai/validation/): Shadow-mode validation before operational use.

## Company and verification

- [About](https://www.3brain.ai/about/): Entity, founder and operating context.
- [Investors](https://www.3brain.ai/investors/): Public investor overview; detailed materials remain private.
- [Contact](https://www.3brain.ai/contact/): CRI and investor contact routes.
- [Imprint](https://www.3brain.ai/imprint/): Legal entities and website operator.

## Boundaries

- CRI supports accountable human review and does not make autonomous project or credit decisions.
- Public Evidence Pack content is synthetic or clearly identified as illustrative.
- Earth Observation is an input medium; the product is the governed Evidence Pack and review workflow.
